review.source_review: Annual OIC comparison is an additive explicit-cell file route; the existing net-debt exercise and ordinary FDD engine contract are unchanged. The maintained source selector adds declared requirements and wrapper references. Studio Archive now restores approved roots in a new isolated session and offers a separate selected-source standalone context for specifically supported one-off workflows; the course still uses explicit synthetic client preparation and actual Archive receipts. Bank receipt sealing and optional local-only data reports preserve their committed controls. Compare complete authored course/fixture/locale/timing objects against all three committed parents, preserving prior editorial judgments and historical artifact reviews. Fresh CI must verify current native demo/practice identities and digests. No new learner, visual, professional or installed-host acceptance is claimed.
